    # Create adjacency list
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    for a, b, c in edges:
        adj[a - 1].append((b - 1, c))
        adj[b - 1].append((a - 1, c))
    
    # Calculate the minimum weight to reduce degrees to at most x
    result = [0] * n
    
    # For each vertex, calculate the sum of the k largest weights
    for i in range(n):
        # Get all edge weights connected to vertex i
        weights = [c for _, c in adj[i]]

        weights.sort(reverse=True)
